description: Energy System Simulator is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Diogo Ribeiro (ESMAD, Politécnico do Porto). A transparent, optimisation-based simulator for an electrical energy system with renewable generation, dispatchable thermal plants, storage, reservoir hydro, demand response, imports, distribution constraints, and hourly end-user consumption. The model is designed for research, teaching, and policy experiments. It uses explicit physical and economic constraints, not machine-learning methods. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is BUSL-1.1. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
